scope: One owner-authorized bounded pretrained-base-preserving residual test. No full fit.
question: Does holding the pretrained head and its Adam state fixed avoid the common harmful count shift during joint adapter fine-tuning, and does ordered input beat matched-capacity summary input?

architecture.per_level: Conv2d(2,4,3,padding1) -> GELU -> flatten36 -> Linear(36,3); 187 parameters x3 levels.
architecture.features: Unchanged frozen pretrained SAM2 native reference/query128/64/32 and geometry.
architecture.location: Residual adds to original three matching summaries before unchanged exemplar mean/max aggregation and decoder.
architecture.initialization: Fixed isolated construction seed2027, same adapter parameters in all arms, zero output projection/bias; base weights and initial predictions equal native pretrained A0.
architecture.original: Identical adapter graph multiplied by zero; 561 dormant parameters. Effective capacity equals original; active capacity is matched among the other three arms.
architecture.summary_residual: Repeat [adaptive score, mean, variance] three times to form9 values, plus native validity mask. No additional raw correspondence information.
architecture.ordered_parts: Prespecified primary: nine native ordered part scores plus supplied-boundary validity in a2x3x3 tensor per query location/exemplar.
architecture.permuted_parts: Same score/validity pairs under one fixed bijection, not information destruction; tests ordered part inductive bias. A network may learn around this permutation.
architecture.inference: Image features, native visual exemplars and their geometry only; no counts/points/masks/category labels.
architecture.frozen_summary: Identical summary_residual graph with original head/Adam states held fixed.
architecture.frozen_ordered: Primary: identical ordered_parts graph with original head/Adam states held fixed.

training.objective: Unchanged joint_objective: count + .25 regional + .5 conserved-blur +5 normalized marginal CDF.
training.base_optimizer: Restore authentic saved state age4536. Compute its gradients and global clip, then set base gradients None immediately before Adam.step; original weights/moments/age remain bitwise unchanged every step.
training.new_optimizer: Same AdamW hyperparameters, fresh zero moments/age0 for added parameters in every arm; separate parameter group.
training.clipping: Compute all base+adapter gradients and unchanged global norm1 first; mask base afterward. This preserves first-step adapter updates versus joint training.
training.RNG: Exact saved generator/CPU/CUDA states restored before every arm.
training.precision: CUDA BF16 forward/FP32 counts and losses, TF32off, 2CPU threads.
training.data: Same256 fitting images,32 batches8, one pass, no augmentation; unchanged source native counts/points.
training.compute: Two new 32-step arms, full forward/backward retained for gradient-processing control. Reuse completed joint arms; no equal walltime or joint/frozen updated-parameter-count claim.

readout.previously_seen: All readouts are source-fitting images seen by the pretrained checkpoint and reused for diagnostics. No independent validation claim.
readout.endpoints: Reuse four verified historical endpoints baseline/original/summary_residual/ordered_parts, verify current baseline, add two frozen32-step endpoints and two equal adapter-displacement readouts.
readout.displacement_control: Shrink new frozen endpoints to smaller adapter displacement. Old joint endpoints were discarded; no fabricated joint/frozen displacement match or rerun.

gate.practical_gain: At least1% MAE reduction in each dense group against every reference, beyond numerical tolerance.
gate.count_protection: Overall MAE/RMSE/class-macro; sparse and both medium bins MAE/RMSE.
gate.spatial_protection: GAME1/2/3 and normalized blur in every populated stratum; >=1% normalized blur improvement overall/dense/extreme.
gate.extreme_individual_protection: Every one of seven extreme absolute errors protected against all protection references.
gate.displacement: Same dense gains and protections between matched_frozen_ordered and matched_frozen_summary only.

resource_policy.shared_GPU: Explicit owner approval retained for this bounded test

limitations: Fitting probes seen by checkpoint and reused in development, not unseen accuracy.
A failure does not rule out longer or fresh-initialization learning.
Frozen-base adapters and staged fine-tuning have existing precedent; this is a diagnostic, not a novelty claim.
Freezing base does not fix its output: the inserted residual can still alter counts and spatial errors.
Joint/frozen comparison changes updated capacity intentionally; new summary/ordered arms have identical active561 capacity.
No discarded historical weights can be reconstructed from saved counts; joint/frozen net displacements are not matched.
subsequent_action: Report the full gate before any full training. A pass does not authorize a full run.
